stories.title: La Policía se despliega en El Guano para desalojar otro asentamiento de inmigrantes en Ceuta 48 horas antes de la visita de los Reyes

en.title: Police deploy in El Guano to evict another immigrant settlement in Ceuta 48 hours before the King's visit
en.summary: Police are conducting an eviction operation in El Guano, Ceuta, where several hundred Moroccan nationals are camping following earlier removals from other beach areas.

stories.title: Máximo Quiles vence en Indonesia y se proclama campeón del mundo

en.title: Máximo Quiles wins in Indonesia and becomes world champion
en.summary: Máximo Quiles secures the world championship title, with Spanish competitors David Almansa and Brian Uriarte, both riding KTM motorcycles, joining him on the podium.

stories.title: Una docena de muertos y más de 300 heridos en un ataque hutí contra el aeropuerto de Riad, la capital de Arabia Saudí

en.title: Dozen dead and more than 300 wounded in Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, Saudi Arabia's capital
en.summary: A Houthi attack on Riyadh airport kills approximately twelve people including four Saudi citizens and one American, with over 300 injured. All air operations at the airport have been suspended.

stories.title: Máximo Quiles toca el cielo: el pupilo de Marc Márquez se corona campeón del mundo de Moto3

en.title: Máximo Quiles reaches the top: Marc Márquez's protégé becomes Moto3 world champion
en.summary: Máximo Quiles, a young rider from Murcia born in 2008, wins the Moto3 world championship after victory at the Mandalika circuit starting from sixth position. He achieved ten race wins and fifteen podiums during an outstanding season.

stories.title: Culmina el desalojo del último gran asentamiento de migrantes en Ceuta

en.title: Eviction of last major migrant settlement in Ceuta completed
en.summary: Police forces conducted an operation at the El Guano esplanade to clear a large migrant encampment in Ceuta.

stories.title: La Policía se despliega en la playa de El Guano de Ceuta para desalojar el último gran asentamiento ilegal de inmigrantes

en.title: Police deploy on El Guano beach in Ceuta to clear last major illegal immigrant settlement
en.summary: Police removed fewer than one thousand Moroccan migrants from an encampment on El Guano beach, following previous clearances at other Ceuta beaches.

stories.title: Los secretos del ‘espía’ alemán August Hanning

en.title: Secrets of German 'spy' August Hanning
en.summary: Germany imprisoned a former intelligence chief suspected of providing information to foreign countries while working as a security consultant.

stories.title: Ceuta se prepara para la visita de los Reyes

en.title: Ceuta prepares for the Kings' visit
en.summary: Ceuta undertook cleaning and decorative preparations in anticipation of a royal visit over the weekend.

stories.title: August Hanning, el espía alemán que se vendía al mejor postor

en.title: August Hanning, the German spy who sold himself to the highest bidder
en.summary: A former head of Germany's foreign intelligence service is suspected of working for dictatorial regimes over several years.

stories.title: El Madrid, de nuevo contra los árbitros: Mourinho se niega a salir en rueda de prensa tras la roja a Vinicius, que pide "perdón" y se podría perder el clásico

en.title: Madrid, once again against referees: Mourinho refuses to attend press conference after Vinicius's red card, who asks for "forgiveness" and could miss the classic
en.summary: Real Madrid's coach declined to address media following a controversial red card to Vinicius during a match where the team expressed frustration with referee decisions.

stories.title: Al menos 12 muertos y más de 300 heridos en el aeropuerto de Riad tras un ataque atribuido a los hutíes

en.title: At least 12 dead and over 300 injured at Riyadh airport after attack attributed to Houthis
en.summary: An attack at a Saudi Arabian airport resulted in multiple casualties and injuries. The incident represents the deadliest attack in Saudi Arabia since a 2015 suicide bombing.

stories.title: Un ataque al aeropuerto de Riad causa 12 muertos y más de 300 heridos

en.title: Attack on Riyadh airport causes 12 dead and over 300 injured
en.summary: An airport in Saudi Arabia came under military attack, resulting in casualties. A second airport facility in the country also faced military action.

stories.title: Vox propone construir "masivamente" vivienda social y adjudicarla con "prioridad nacional"

en.title: Vox proposes building "massively" social housing and awarding it with "national priority"
en.summary: The general secretary of the Spanish political party Vox proposed constructing large quantities of social housing with allocation based on national priority, prioritizing Spanish citizens in housing allocation lists.

stories.title: Las diez innovaciones con las que Decathlon quiere hacer más accesible practicar deporte

en.title: Ten innovations with which Decathlon wants to make practicing sport more accessible
en.summary: Decathlon held its Innovation Awards 2026 in Lille, where ten teams presented proposals including shoes that measure cushioning wear and cycling gear with airbag technology. The competition showcased the industrial scale of the group, which has annual revenue of 16.8 billion euros.

stories.title: Cómo funcionará la nueva cuenta de inversión del Gobierno

en.title: How the Government's new investment account will work
en.summary: A new investment vehicle for small savers allows contributions up to 150,000 euros and offers tax advantages to encourage investment in European stock markets.

stories.title: Guía para inquilinos y propietarios: cómo afecta la nueva regulación de la vivienda

en.title: Guide for tenants and landlords: how the new housing regulation affects you
en.summary: The first of two housing decrees approved by the Government took effect, redefining the rental and purchase market. Parliament's Standing Commission will ratify it on Friday.

stories.title: La amenaza latente para el mercado del alquiler: renovación automática con sanciones al casero

en.title: The latent threat to the rental market: automatic renewal with sanctions for landlords
en.summary: A second decree imposes minimum penalties of 12 months' rent on landlords who refuse to renew contracts after expiration.
